name: Dashboard Detox – Hide Marketing & Review Popups
author: Digital Lychee

sections.description:
Your WordPress dashboard shouldn’t feel like Times Square.

Dashboard Detox removes the noise — stopping marketing messages, “rate this plugin” nags, upgrade prompts, sales banners, Black Friday ads, and countless popup notices that keep interrupting your workflow.

It works automatically, with no setup needed, and includes a lightweight optional settings page for power users.

Perfect for developers, agencies, and anyone who wants wp-admin to stay clean and distraction-free.

✨ Features

  • Automatically hides:

    • Review nags (“Please rate us 5 stars!”)
    • Upgrade / Go Pro messages
    • Sales, discount and Black Friday banners
    • Newsletter signup popups
    • Promotional overlays
    • Persistent admin notices that reappear when closed

  • Smart and safe:

    • Attempts to avoid hiding core update or security notices
    • Uses keyword detection instead of blindly removing all notices
    • Lightweight inline script only
    • No front-end impact
    • No performance overhead

No setup required. Just activate and detox your dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/dl-dashboard-detox,
    or install via Plugins → Add New → “Dashboard Detox”.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Enjoy a calmer wp-admin.
sections.faq:
Does this hide core update notifications?

Dashboard Detox tries very hard not to hide:
– WordPress update alerts
– Plugin/theme update notifications
– Security warnings

Only marketing and review-style notices are targeted.

Will this break other plugins?

No. Notices are only hidden visually using JS/CSS.
No plugin files or database entries are modified.

Do I need to configure anything?

No — the plugin works immediately with zero settings.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes — Dashboard Detox Pro adds custom keyword rules, whitelists, debug mode and more.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Improved standards compliance by switching to proper asset enqueueing for both CSS and JavaScript, using WordPress API functions.
  • Replaced inline <style> injection with registered and enqueued admin styles, including inline CSS.
  • Updated Author URI to a dedicated, lightweight plugin landing page for improved reliability.
  • Minor internal refactoring and cleanup.

1.0.2

  • Added stronger, more aggressive hiding logic to fully remove marketing popups, overlays, banners and review nags from both layout and interaction flow.
  • Refined pre-hide behaviour to ensure zero layout shift during page load.

1.0.1

  • Improved notice handling to fully remove hidden popups from layout.
  • Added stronger .dl-dashboard-detox-hidden class to prevent ghost overlays, click-blocking, and leftover spacing.
  • Updated JS logic to rely on the new class instead of inline styles.
  • Ensures hidden elements no longer intercept clicks or affect admin page layout.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Automatically hides common marketing, review and upsell notices.
  • Avoids core and security-related notifications.
  • Lightweight inline script, zero configuration needed.

short_description: A lightweight plugin hiding marketing popups, review nags and upsells in wp-admin, keeping your WordPress dashboard clean, quiet and distraction-free.
